characters.title: Maya

Her arms rest loosely away from her torso with both hands fully visible, one hand open beside each hip, while her feet remain planted apart in a relaxed neutral stance. Black cargo pants fall in broad creases down to the ankles, with large flap pockets on both thighs and smaller side pockets. The entire figure remains unobstructed against the simple background, with ample empty space surrounding her braids, hands, and shoes.
